6.0.3.changelog: Fix Tasks/Subtasks not being populated or updated in story files during enhanced sprint pipeline

6.0.4.changelog: Added Step 8b (Edge Case Hunter review) — runs in parallel with code review and adversarial review. Leverages new BMAD 6.0.4 review-edge-case-hunter.xml task for method-driven path enumeration.

6.2.0.changelog: Consolidated review (BMAD 6.2 runs adversarial + edge case + acceptance internally). E2E TDD step runs red-phase E2E tests in parallel with unit TDD. Updated for .claude/skills/ architecture.

6.4.0.changelog: Skill renames /bmad-bmm-* → /bmad-* (6.3.0 agent consolidation: Quinn QA, Bob SM, Barry → Amelia). Pipeline restructured 11 → 9 steps: Step 3 is now a fresh-context Opus runner that executes BMAD's bmad-create-story/checklist.md; Step 4 unit-TDD dropped (Amelia writes Kent-Beck-style unit tests inline in dev-story); Step 10 AC-trace dropped (Acceptance Auditor inside Step 7 covers it). Phase 0 epic-context cache compiled once and reused across Steps 1/5/7. New unattended-by-default behavior (only ambiguous merge conflicts pause), per-story auto-commit at Step 9 with submodule-first sequence (never auto-pushes), codebase anti-leak rules injected into Steps 5/6/8/9 (no BMAD/story-ID references in code or main-repo commits), and a deferred-decisions log artifact for every judgment call. Hotfix port: version label bumped only — Step 0 self-detection logic unchanged for 6.4 surfaces.

6.6.0.changelog: Config-source patch for BMAD 6.6 (#2348): `project_name` moved from `_bmad/bmm/config.yaml` to `_bmad/core/config.yaml`. Phase 0 step 1 and the Configuration table now reflect the two-file split (core vs bmm) and prefer the core copy when both exist (matches installer auto-migration precedence). 6.5.0 brought no script-affecting changes (agent-platform additions only); skill paths and command names verified unchanged from 6.4.0. Hotfix unchanged.

6.8.0.changelog: BMAD 6.8 support. Skill/command names verified UNCHANGED 6.6→6.8 (/bmad-create-story, /bmad-dev-story, /bmad-code-review, /bmad-qa-generate-e2e-tests, /bmad-sprint-status, /bmad-correct-course) and story-status vocabulary unchanged — no document conversion required for the pipeline's inputs (stories/epics/sprint-status/PRD all forward-compatible). 6.8 breaking changes (bmad-create-ux-design → bmad-ux two-spine DESIGN.md+EXPERIENCE.md; bmad-distillator → bmad-spec) are planning surfaces the sprint does not consume. PATH FIX: support-file reads (methods.csv, create-story checklist.md, compile-epic-context.md) now resolve through a Phase-0-detected ${BMAD_SKILLS_ROOT} (canonical .claude/skills/<skill>/, with legacy _bmad/ fallback cascade) — the old _bmad/bmm/skills/ and _bmad/core/workflows/ paths were stale since the 6.2 .claude/skills move. NEW baseline_commit handling (#2403): dev-story stamps baseline_commit into story frontmatter and code-review uses it as the diff base; Step 7 now constrains review scope to the story File List to prevent cross-story over-scoping from sibling worktree merges, and notes that yolo + baseline_commit keep code-review unattended (no branch-confirm HALT). Added project_context (#2422) to the env block (optional, skills self-resolve). .decision-log.md (6.7) confirmed planning-only — no coexistence concern. Hotfix: version label bumped to 6.8.0 only. IN-VERSION REVISION (2026-07-15, tuned from 22 stories / ~25.6M subagent tokens of harness-reported usage across three consecutive sprints): Step 1.5 classifier sonnet→haiku with slim prompt (no env block), skipped entirely on --tier=/:suffix override, lite-below-high-confidence promoted to standard; Step 9 opus→sonnet (pure git mechanics, ambiguous conflicts still hard-pause); Step 10 folded to coordinator-inline sprint-status.yaml edits with ONE /bmad-sprint-status reconcile agent at epic close-out; Step 2 elicitation input capped to description+ACs+Tasks/Subtasks+epic-context cache (Dev Notes per-subsection only); mid-epic epic-context recompile after every 3rd completed story; Step 7 review liveness protocol (SendMessage nudge before respawn, collect late child-hunter findings before Step 9 commits); Steps 5/8 standardized on opus across all surfaces. NEW always-on token-usage log: coordinator writes {implementation_artifacts}/sprint-epic-<ID>-token-usage.md every sprint by default — per-spawn harness-reported rows (incl. retries and killed/degraded/stalled spawns), per-story totals, sprint-end step averages, waste %, and trim/bulk observations vs prior sprints; coordinator-only, never injected into agent prompts.
